content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To paint with squirt guns, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Attach the finished canvas to the drying rack (5 minutes)
Step 2. Mix a custom shade of turquoise (10 minutes)
Step 3. Put on a protective plastic poncho (2 minutes)
Step 4. Tape the edges of the canvas (15 minutes)
Step 5. Lay out the drop cloth (10 minutes)
Step 6. Fill the first water gun with red paint (3 minutes)
Step 7. Take a photo of the final artwork (2 minutes)
Step 8. Clean the nozzles of the squirt guns (15 minutes)
Step 9. Dilute the acrylic paint with water (10 minutes)
Step 10. Label the back of the canvas with the date (1 minute)
Step 11. Gather all primary color paint bottles (5 minutes)
Step 12. Unpack the squirt guns from their packaging (5 minutes)
Step 13. Organize the paint bottles by color (5 minutes)
Step 14. Sketch a rough outline on the canvas (20 minutes)
Step 15. Test the spray pattern on a piece of cardboard (2 minutes)
Step 16. Select the best outdoor spot with good lighting (10 minutes)
Step 17. Dispose of used masking tape (2 minutes)
Step 18. Wipe down the work table (10 minutes)
Step 19. Position the canvas on the easel (5 minutes)
Step 20. Fill a bucket with rinse water (3 minutes)
Step 21. Measure the canvas dimensions (5 minutes)
Step 22. Secure the drop cloth with weights (5 minutes)
Step 23. Shake the paint bottles vigorously (2 minutes)
Step 24. Prime the squirt gun triggers (1 minute)
Step 25. Check the weather forecast for wind (2 minutes)
Step 26. Calculate the center point of the canvas (5 minutes)
Step 27. Set up a perimeter around the painting zone (15 minutes)
Step 28. Buy a set of high-capacity squirt guns (1 hour)
Step 29. Purchase a large blank canvas (30 minutes)
Step 30. Clear a space in the garage for storage (20 minutes)
Step 31. Design the abstract pattern on paper (45 minutes)
Step 32. Invite friends to help with the project (15 minutes)
Step 33. Set a timer for the painting session (1 minute)
Step 34. Begin squirt gun firing at the canvas (20 minutes)
Step 35. Prepare a cleaning station with towels (15 minutes)
Step 36. Remove the protective poncho (1 minute)
Step 37. Refill the squirt guns with secondary colors (10 minutes)
Step 38. Allow the paint to settle for a moment (30 minutes)
Step 39. Put on safety goggles (1 minute)
Step 40. Mix a batch of thin orange paint (10 minutes)
Step 41. Lay out old newspapers (10 minutes)
Step 42. Mount the canvas frame (15 minutes)
Step 43. Check the pressure in the water guns (2 minutes)
Step 44. Set up the easel in the yard (10 minutes)
Step 45. Sign the bottom corner of the canvas (2 minutes)
Step 46. Inspect the guns for leaks (5 minutes)
Step 47. Choose a color palette (10 minutes)
Step 48. Buy a pack of plastic drop cloths (20 minutes)
Step 49. Fire the first burst of paint (10 seconds)
Step 50. Locate the safety gear (5 minutes)
Step 51. Stir the paint mixtures (5 minutes)
Step 52. Adjust the spray nozzle settings (2 minutes)
Step 53. Prepare the tape rolls (2 minutes)
Step 54. Put on old clothes (10 minutes)
Step 55. Sweep the painting area (10 minutes)
Step 56. Open the paint containers (2 minutes)
Step 57. Store the clean guns for next time (5 minutes)
Step 58. Check the consistency of the paint (3 minutes)
Step 59. Double-check the easel stability (2 minutes)
Step 60. Finalize the abstract design plan (10 minutes)
